# What do returns really cost your store?

> Paste your orders and refunds and see what each return really costs, which product categories lose money after returns, and whether a return fee or restocking fee would pay. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/returns-policy-cost-analyzer/)
- [What a return really costs, and when a return fee pays](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/returns-policy-cost-analyzer/returns-policy-guide.html)
